basis: Reconciled against Certificate of Waiver and Authorization 107W-2026-01762 as issued, effective 13 AUG 2026 to 31 JAN 2030, which supersedes 107W-2025-04534. Version 4.0 restates the shielded/non-shielded split, the three operations-over-non-participants pathways, the UASFM grid authorization and NOTAM requirement, and the EP operating interpretations documented under interpretations in this file. Trims Aircraft & Equipment to site-invariant items (aircraft-state checks such as Remote ID, ADS-B, maintenance log and FCC compliance now belong on a separate pre-flight readiness checklist, not a per-site record), removes duplicate Shielding Geometry and Property items already covered elsewhere, and splits the applicable sections between ground-crew and RPIC items with a single RPIC attestation gating final approval. Items carried over from the superseded certificate as EP practice are labelled as such.

rules.label: Site name or ID
rules.failReason: Site name or ID is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter a unique site name or identifier.

rules.label: Site location
rules.failReason: Site address or coordinates are required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter an address or capture site coordinates.

rules.label: Assessment date
rules.failReason: Assessment date is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter the assessment date.

rules.label: Assessed by
rules.failReason: Assessor name is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter who completed the assessment.

rules.label: RPIC reviewing
rules.failReason: RPIC review entry is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter the reviewing RPIC.

rules.label: Launch method
rules.failReason: Launch method is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Select tactical, dock, or both.

rules.provision: Non-PRS Overflight, Maximum Takeoff Weight (SP 13(f)), PRS-Equipped Overflight, Maximum Takeoff Weight (SP 14(d)), Light Aircraft Overflight, Maximum Takeoff Weight (SP 15(c))
rules.label: Maximum takeoff weight recorded
rules.failReason: Aircraft maximum takeoff weight has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record maximum takeoff weight including all attachments. Weight selects the operations-over-non-participants pathway (Non-PRS Overflight of Non-Participants (Restricted-Access Site) (SP 13), PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14) or Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15)).

rules.label: Weight within Non-PRS Overflight of Non-Participants (Restricted-Access Site) (SP 13) ceiling
rules.failReason: Maximum takeoff weight exceeds 8.8 lb (4.0 kg), the ceiling for non-PRS operations over non-participants.
rules.correctiveAction: Use an aircraft at or below 8.8 lb, fit a conforming PRS (PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14), 10 lb ceiling), or plan the route to avoid overflight of non-participants and moving vehicles.

rules.label: Weight within PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14) ceiling
rules.failReason: Maximum takeoff weight exceeds 10 lb, the ceiling for PRS-equipped operations over non-participants.
rules.correctiveAction: Use an aircraft at or below 10 lb, or plan the route to avoid overflight of non-participants and moving vehicles.

rules.label: PRS minimum deployment height recorded
rules.failReason: PRS manufacturer minimum deployment height has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the minimum deployment height from the PRS operator manual. The aircraft may not be operated lower than it.

rules.provision: Light Aircraft Overflight, Rotating Component Shielding (SP 15(d))
rules.label: Rotating component shielding fitted
rules.failReason: Prop guards or an equivalent laceration-prevention system have not been verified for the Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15) pathway.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify prop guards or a laceration-prevention system are fitted. Weight including all attachments must remain at or below 0.88 lb.

rules.label: Anti-collision lighting
rules.failReason: Anti-collision lighting has not been verified operational.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify 107.29-compliant anti-collision lighting is fitted and operational at all times.

rules.provision: Multiple UAS Operations, Aircraft and FMS as Specified (SP 17(a))
rules.label: No more than six aircraft
rules.failReason: More than six aircraft are planned for simultaneous operation.
rules.correctiveAction: Reduce simultaneous aircraft to six or fewer.

rules.label: Obstruction continuity recorded
rules.failReason: Obstruction continuity has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record whether obstruction is continuous, present with gaps, or absent along the entire route. This selects Shielded Operations (SP 11) (shielded) or Non-Shielded Operations (SP 12) (non-shielded).

rules.label: DAA status recorded
rules.failReason: DAA status at this site has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record whether DAA is unused, active and observed, or installed with compromised coverage.

rules.label: Non-shielded mitigation present
rules.failReason: Non-shielded with neither DAA nor a Visual Observer. Non-Shielded Operations (SP 12) offers two alternatives, DAA or VO(s). With neither, this is not an operation under this waiver.
rules.correctiveAction: Conduct the flight under standard Part 107 within visual line of sight, reclassify as Shielded Operations (SP 11) shielded, assign VO(s) sufficient for a 2 SM radius, or use the DAA system described in the waiver application.

rules.label: Shielding gaps documented
rules.failReason: Shielding gaps have not been identified and documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify every segment that reclassifies to Non-Shielded Operations (SP 12) and document it. The certificate provides no partial-shielding allowance.

rules.provision: Non-PRS Overflight of Non-Participants (Restricted-Access Site) (SP 13), PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14), Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15)
rules.label: Open-air assembly exposure recorded
rules.failReason: Whether an open-air assembly of persons is present in the operational area has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record whether any open-air assembly of persons is within or adjacent to the planned route.

rules.provision: Overflight, Open-Air Assembly Prohibition (SP 13(c)), Overflight, Open-Air Assembly Prohibition (SP 14(a)), Overflight, Open-Air Assembly Prohibition (SP 15(a))
rules.label: No open-air assembly overflight
rules.failReason: Operations over open-air assemblies of persons are prohibited under every pathway of this certificate. There is no coordination alternative.
rules.correctiveAction: Exclude the assembly from the operational area and route, or do not fly under this waiver while it is present.

rules.provision: Overflight, No Sustained Operations (SP 13(d)), Overflight, No Sustained Operations (SP 14(b)), Overflight, No Sustained Operations (SP 15(b))
rules.label: No sustained operations over non-participants or vehicles
rules.failReason: Sustained operations over non-participants or moving vehicles (loitering, hovering, continuous or sequential overflight) are prohibited under every pathway. The closed-site exception in the superseded certificate no longer exists.
rules.correctiveAction: Redesign the route so overflight is transitory only, or remove overflight from the plan.

rules.label: UASFM operation status recorded
rules.failReason: Whether the site relies on the UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16) §107.41 authorization (at or below UASFM grid altitudes) has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record whether operations at this site rely on UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16).

rules.provision: Non-Shielded Operations, VO Positioning and Communication (SP 12(d)), Non-Shielded Operations, VO Communication Equipment (SP 12(e))
rules.label: Direct voice with every VO
rules.failReason: Direct voice communication with every VO has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm continuous full-duplex, hands-free voice with each VO and a reliable backup. Operations cease if voice is lost (Cease Operations on Loss of VO Communication (SP 21(c))).

rules.label: VO count sufficient for 2 SM
rules.failReason: VO coverage of a 2 statute mile radius has not been confirmed. This is the definition of sufficient VO(s) under Non-Shielded Operations, Visual Observer Coverage (SP 12(c)).
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the number of VOs continuously observes at least a 2 SM radius around the aircraft, or add VOs.

rules.label: VO training documented
rules.failReason: Documented VO training (operational volume scanning, communications and phraseology, overall waiver operations) has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm each VO has documented training for the Non-Shielded Operations, VO Training (SP 12(f)) items.

rules.provision: Non-PRS Overflight, Restricted Access and PPE (SP 13(a))
rules.label: Restricted access site
rules.failReason: Operations over non-participants with an aircraft over 0.88 lb and no PRS require a site restricted from the general public, with persons present related to the site.
rules.correctiveAction: Restrict site access to the general public, fit a conforming PRS (PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14)), use an aircraft at or below 0.88 lb (Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15)), or plan the route to avoid overflight.

rules.provision: Non-PRS Overflight, Restricted Access and PPE (SP 13(a))
rules.label: Persons on site equipped with PPE
rules.failReason: Persons in the operational area have not been confirmed as site-related and equipped with appropriate PPE (hard hats, gloves, work boots or similar).
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the client will require PPE for persons in the operational area during operations, or use the PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14) or Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15) pathway.

rules.provision: Non-PRS Overflight, Notification of Authorized Persons (SP 13(b))
rules.label: Authorized persons notified
rules.failReason: Notification of all persons authorized inside the operational area has not been addressed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm every person authorized inside the operational area will be notified of UAS operations.

rules.provision: Overflight, Route Design to Avoid People and Traffic (SP 13(e)), Overflight, Route Design to Avoid People and Traffic (SP 14(c))
rules.label: Routes designed to avoid overflight
rules.failReason: Flight paths and routes have not been confirmed as designed to avoid overflight of human beings and traffic areas.
rules.correctiveAction: Design and document routes that avoid overflight of human beings and traffic areas. Any overflight must be transitory.

rules.label: PRS operational and ASTM F3322-18
rules.failReason: PRS has not been confirmed operational and compliant with ASTM F3322-18 as revised.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm PRS conformance and operational status before flight.

rules.label: Planned altitude at or above PRS minimum
rules.failReason: Planned altitude is below the PRS manufacturer minimum deployment height.
rules.correctiveAction: Raise the planned altitude to at least the PRS minimum deployment height, or use another pathway.

rules.label: Airspace classification confirmed
rules.failReason: Airspace classification has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm and document the airspace class at the site.

rules.provision: UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16), 14 CFR 107.41
rules.label: Airspace authorization basis confirmed
rules.failReason: Airspace authorization basis has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Class G: none required. Controlled airspace at or below the UASFM grid: UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16) authorizes it with a NOTAM. Above the grid or grid zero: separate ATC authorization; LAANC may not be used for waivered operations.

rules.label: UASFM grid ceiling recorded
rules.failReason: The UASFM grid altitude at this site has not been recorded. Shielded Operations, UASFM Grid Precedence (SP 11(c)) makes it the controlling altitude and UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16) limits the authorization to it.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the published UASFM grid altitude for the site.

rules.label: NOTAM procedure assigned
rules.failReason: The NOTAM filing procedure for UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16) operations has not been assigned.
rules.correctiveAction: Assign responsibility to file a NOTAM no more than 72 and no less than 24 hours before operations, and to verify it is issued before flight.

rules.label: Planned altitude within UASFM grid
rules.failReason: Planned altitude exceeds the UASFM grid altitude. UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16) authorizes operations only at or below it.
rules.correctiveAction: Lower the planned altitude to the grid altitude or obtain a separate ATC authorization.

rules.label: Facilities within 3 miles identified
rules.failReason: Airports, heliports, known agricultural aerial application operations and aerial military installations within a 3 mile radius have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify every such facility within a 3 mile radius. The provision states 3 miles, not 3 nautical miles.

rules.label: 3 mile notifications sent
rules.failReason: Documented notification to facilities within the 3 mile radius has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Send and document notification to each facility identified.

rules.provision: EP practice, carried over from the superseded certificate
rules.label: Low-level operations within 1 SM identified
rules.failReason: Areas or routes of low-level helicopter and airplane operations within one statute mile have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify helipads, grass airstrips, airports, MOAs below 500 ft AGL, tour operators, and agricultural airstrips within 1 SM. Retained as EP practice; not stated in 107W-2026-01762.

rules.label: TFRs reviewed
rules.failReason: TFR review has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Review TFR activity and document no operational conflict.

rules.label: NOTAMs reviewed
rules.failReason: NOTAM review has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Review NOTAMs and document no operational conflict.

rules.label: Special use airspace cleared
rules.failReason: Restricted, prohibited, or special use airspace conflict has not been cleared.
rules.correctiveAction: Resolve the conflict or mark the site not approved.

rules.provision: Waiver Not Combined With Other Authorizations (SP 2)
rules.label: Waiver not combined
rules.failReason: Confirmation that this waiver is not combined with another authorization has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm no other waiver, authorization, or exemption is being combined without specific FAA authorization.

rules.label: Property boundaries confirmed
rules.failReason: Property boundaries have not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm boundaries by survey, plat, or client record.

rules.failReason: Controlled access has not been verified.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify gates, fencing, or equivalent access controls.

rules.label: Non-participant notification
rules.failReason: Notification of non-participants inside the operational area has not been addressed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm non-participants will be notified of operations. Mandatory under Non-PRS Overflight, Notification of Authorized Persons (SP 13(b)) on that pathway; EP practice otherwise.

rules.correctiveAction: Identify and record the client POC.

rules.label: Computed maximum altitude recorded
rules.failReason: Computed maximum altitude for this site has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the computed maximum AGL and brief it to the crew.

rules.label: 100 ft lateral radius confirmed
rules.failReason: The 100 ft lateral radius from the controlling obstruction has not been confirmed along the route.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the aircraft remains within 100 ft laterally of a qualifying obstruction wherever it relies on Shielded Operations, Obstruction Geometry (SP 11(b)) above 200 ft AGL.

rules.label: Continuity confirmed

rules.correctiveAction: Confirm continuity through climb, cruise, and descent.

rules.label: UASFM grid height applied to shielded altitude
rules.failReason: Precedence of the UASFM grid height over the computed shielded altitude has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the computed altitude does not exceed the published UASFM grid height at the site, or that the site is outside a UASFM grid.

rules.label: Launch and recovery areas designated

rules.correctiveAction: Pre-designate and document launch and recovery areas.

rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the areas will be monitored to keep non-participants out before, during, and immediately after flight.

rules.label: Emergency landing zones identified

rules.label: Overhead hazards cleared
rules.failReason: Overhead hazards at launch and landing have not been cleared.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm no power lines, cranes, or lifts over the launch or landing area.

rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the dock lets the RPIC determine the aircraft is safe for flight, clear the immediate flight area, and assess weather at the dock from the remote location.

rules.label: Every segment designated

conditions.text: Operate only within the assessed site, documented route, mapped geofence, and approved operational volume (Shielded Operations, Operational Area Confinement (SP 11(d)), Geofencing of the Operational Volume (SP 18(c)), Site Selection Performance Procedures (SP 32)).
The RPIC must verify airspace status, NOTAMs, TFRs, weather, aircraft status, crew readiness, and site conditions before each operational period.
C2 link health, telemetry continuity, command response, and video stability must be confirmed before launch and monitored during flight (Ground Control Station Configuration (SP 27)).
Lost link, RTH, emergency descent, and recovery procedures must remain inside the assessed containment area (Return-to-Home Containment (SP 18(d)), Lost Link Procedures (SP 22)).
Emergency landing and recovery areas documented in this assessment must remain available and free of new hazards.
Stop operations and reassess if ground risk exposure, access control, RF or C2 conditions, obstacles, construction, route geometry, or shielding conditions materially change.
The site must be reassessed no later than the recorded reassessment date.

Airspace: UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16) authorizes operations only at or below the published UASFM grid altitude. Any operation above the grid requires a separate ATC authorization; LAANC may not be used for waivered operations. Class G requires no authorization.

Shielded operations (Shielded Operations (SP 11)): 200 ft AGL, or up to 100 ft above an obstruction within a 100 ft radius of the aircraft, never above 400 ft AGL. The UASFM grid height takes precedence where one applies. No VO or DAA is required by the certificate for shielded operations.

Non-shielded operations (Non-Shielded Operations (SP 12)): 400 ft AGL with active DAA under observation or with VO(s) continuously observing a 2 SM radius. With neither, the flight is not conducted under this waiver.
DAA coverage is compromised at this site and sufficient VOs are not in place. Non-shielded operations are limited to 200 ft AGL (Non-Shielded Operations, DAA Requirement (SP 12(b))).

DAA coverage is compromised at this site. Operations run on the VO pathway (Non-Shielded Operations, Visual Observer Coverage (SP 12(c))) at up to 400 ft AGL; VOs must continuously cover a 2 SM radius and carry see-and-avoid for the entire flight.

Visual Observers must be positioned to identify non-participating aircraft before they enter the operational area and to give the RPIC sufficient notice to remain well clear, with continuous full-duplex hands-free voice and a reliable backup. Operations cease if voice is lost (Non-Shielded Operations (SP 12(c)(d)(e)), Cease Operations on Loss of VO Communication (SP 21(c))).

Operations over non-participants on the Non-PRS Overflight of Non-Participants (Restricted-Access Site) (SP 13) pathway (over 0.88 lb, no PRS): the site stays restricted to the general public, every person in the operational area is site-related, equipped with PPE and notified, overflight is transitory only, routes avoid people and traffic areas, and the aircraft does not exceed 8.8 lb.

Operations over non-participants on the PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14) pathway (over 0.88 lb, PRS): PRS operational and ASTM F3322-18 compliant, verified free of known defects within the previous 7 calendar days, unmodified and repacked by the manufacturer after any deployment, aircraft never below the PRS minimum deployment height, overflight transitory only, aircraft does not exceed 10 lb.

Operations over non-participants on the Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15) pathway (0.88 lb or less including all attachments): rotating component shielding fitted, no sustained overflight including any payload delivery portion of flight.
Operations over open-air assemblies of persons are prohibited on every pathway. If an assembly forms inside the operational area, cease overflight.
Overflight of moving vehicles must be transitory. Loitering, hovering, and continuous or sequential overflight are prohibited.

UASFM Grid Operations / NOTAM Requirement (SP 16) operations: a NOTAM must be filed no more than 72 and no less than 24 hours before operating, and verified issued before flight. Altitude is capped at the UASFM grid height.

Multi-aircraft operations are limited to six aircraft of the make/model and Flight Management System specified in the waiver application, each with an independent flight termination system verified with geofencing before every flight (Multiple UAS Operations (SP 17)).

Dock operations require the dock evaluation under Docking Station Evaluation (SP 25(b)(iv)): the RPIC must be able to determine the aircraft is safe for flight, clear the immediate flight area, and assess weather at the dock from the remote location.
Tactical deployment requires ground personnel to verify launch surface, clearances, communications, and local ground risk before launch.
One or more route segments are designated Yellow. The recorded operating restriction for each applies for the duration of operations at this site.
Medium risk site mitigations must be briefed, documented, and verified by the RPIC before each flight.
Any aircraft that undergoes maintenance completes a logged functional test flight under standard Part 107 before returning to waivered operations (Post-Maintenance Functional Test Flight (SP 30(c))).

interpretations.issue: Captioned 'using VO(s) and or DAA'. Sub-provisions (b) and (c) are alternatives; no configuration without either is described.
interpretations.handling: EP treats a non-shielded profile with neither DAA nor VO(s) as outside the waiver: fly it under standard Part 107 VLOS, or reclassify as Shielded Operations (SP 11) shielded. Shielded operations carry no VO or DAA requirement on the face of the certificate.

interpretations.provision: Non-PRS Overflight of Non-Participants (Restricted-Access Site) (SP 13), PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14), Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15)
interpretations.issue: Non-PRS Overflight of Non-Participants (Restricted-Access Site) (SP 13) and PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14) are captioned 'sUA => 0.88 lbs' and Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15) 'sUA <= 0.88lbs'. An aircraft weighing exactly 0.88 lb falls under both captions.
interpretations.handling: EP applies Overflight of Non-Participants at or Under 0.88 lb (SP 15) at exactly 0.88 lb (the pathway written for that weight, including all attachments) and Non-PRS Overflight of Non-Participants (Restricted-Access Site) (SP 13) or PRS-Equipped Overflight of Non-Participants (SP 14) above it. Written FAA clarification recommended; the boundary is not to be used to select the less restrictive pathway.

interpretations.provision: Overflight, Open-Air Assembly Prohibition (SP 13(c)), Overflight, Open-Air Assembly Prohibition (SP 14(a)), Overflight, Open-Air Assembly Prohibition (SP 15(a))
interpretations.issue: 'Open air assemblies of persons' is undefined in the certificate. The coordination pathway of the superseded certificate (old Anti-Collision Lighting (SP 29)) no longer exists.
interpretations.handling: EP treats the term at its plain meaning: any gathering of persons in the open. Overflight is prohibited on every pathway. Written FAA clarification recommended.

interpretations.issue: The superseded certificate stated items this certificate does not: pre-flight hazard checklist with 1 SM low-level traffic, pedestrian and vehicle traffic, and highest obstacle (old Emitter FCC Compliance (SP 31)); RTH 5 second trigger and altitude (old Site Selection Performance Procedures (SP 32)); illumination or daytime assessment (old Special Provision 38 (SP 38)); simulation testing (old Special Provision 41 (SP 41)); non-participant notification and participant vests (old RPIC Pre-Flight and Operational Duties (SP 18(f)(g))).
interpretations.handling: Retained in this matrix as EP practice, labelled 'EP practice' in the provision column, with the same severity they carried in matrix v2.4. Program Manager decides whether to keep, downgrade, or drop each.
